subject: OBJECT paragraph
notes: Format `OBJECT. [ IMPLEMENTS { interface-name-1 } ... . ]` (cite.py --check 11.8.2 "OBJECT" -> OK §11.8.2 General format). Grammar: objectParagraph `(IDENTIFICATION DIVISION DOT)? OBJECT DOT implementsClause? ...`, implementsClause `IMPLEMENTS interfaceName+ DOT` - one-or-more repetition and the clause's own trailing period, exactly as printed. Probes (probe dir out/probe/object-paragraph (gen.py)): p8 `OBJECT. IMPLEMENTS IA` / `IC.` spanning two lines compiles and runs (CB8-PA, CB8-PC); p2 missing trailing period -> COBOL0307; p11 `IMPLEMENTS .` (empty list) -> COBOL0001; --std 85 -> COBOL0900 (OO gated), 2002/2014 run. IMPLEMENTS stays a user word (§8.10 context-sensitive; OoSpineTests line 2085). Repetition of a name legal (PB946 landed; golden oo_implements_repeated). || Editions (adjudicator, verbatim): 2002, 2014, 2023 (the OO facility, introduced by ISO/IEC 1989:2002; absent from X3.23-1985)
